blocks.text: The Suncast Trash Can Hideaway conceals your unsightly outdoor trashcan from your everyday view. In fact, not just conceal it, but blend it in with your lovely backyard view with its intricate and elegant faux wainscoting design matched with a very warm touch of taupe. The Suncast Hideaway Trash Can is the answer to the question of "how to make my trash can look nice". This stylish trash can with a lid features an attractive design and taupe color to match any decor, may it be indoor or outdoor. It can hold standard 30 to 33-gallon garbage bags, ideal for those big loads that can sometimes overflow and create a huge mess in your sweet home. Here comes the solution to that, this outside garbage can features a convenient lid to keep all your clutter inside the recycling bins. Made out of strong resin material, the yard trash can withstand the most environmental or weather factors such as wind, rain, heat, and many more. No tools are required for assembly so you can easily do it yourself, plus, it can be put together quickly and swiftly in just 5 whole minutes.
